summary: BTC ~$82.7k (+1.0% 24h). New since midday: a false US-Iran peace-deal report briefly pushed BTC to $83.1k before denials reversed it, which shows the range is still headline-driven rather than a real breakout. JPMorgan Asset Management added BTC to its long-term return forecasts for the first time (10% a year base case), a slow-burn positive. FINMA's Swiss retail ETF and the 19 Oct ETF inflows were already counted. Still a 28-day tight range; $80k support, $86k needed for confirmation. Slightly trimmed from midday because the spike faded.
catalyst_note: JPMorgan AM 2027 long-term assumptions include BTC (20 Oct); US-Iran deal report denied (20 Oct, not a catalyst)
